# 员工伤病报告政策与记录访问响应

## 任务

你是美国业务企业法务运营专员。制造厂现有员工政策存在报告威慑及记录访问错误，需修为可下发政策并处理六类访问请求。 本题是原创虚构业务委托；官方附件是真实法源，不把虚构业务视为真实数据。

## 输入材料

输入目录 `/app/input_files/` 只读。请使用随包附件，不依赖联网检索。

- `/app/input_files/CFR_1904_35_2025.pdf`：官方2025 CFR员工参与、反报复及记录访问规则
- `/app/input_files/policy_draft.docx`：八条原创虚构错误政策
- `/app/input_files/request_queue.xlsx`：六项原创虚构身份与访问请求
- `/app/input_files/scope.docx`：OSHA覆盖假设、现有渠道、隐私与时间边界

## 工作要求

- [Q0] 按附件列明的历史法源版本作美国联邦法演练；每一法律结论附附件文件名及条款/分项定位。不要声称已进行律师审定、实时法更新或附件外事实核查；不需要联网。
- [Q1] 逐条重写P1–P8为可直接下发英文政策并定位条款；纠正迟报自动惩罚、单一路径、权利否认、报告报复、300时限/姓名、union301范围/时限、首份收费和个人代表资格。
- [Q2] 为R1–R6逐项写权利或无权、文字时限、材料及字段限制、首份/重复份收费和条款；不伪造收件日期及记录内容，不把privacy-case合法匿名误当成应恢复姓名。
- [Q3] 形成四条主管行动卡：合理接收及替代渠道、反报复、及时转办与不同期限、身份核实与隐私边界。

## 交付文件

- `/app/output/employee_policy.docx`：八条英文直接替代政策及条款
- `/app/output/access_decisions.xlsx`：六个ID的权利/时限/披露范围/收费/依据
- `/app/output/supervisor_card.docx`：四条可执行主管培训卡

## 硬约束

仅将交付物写入 `/app/output/`，文件名须与要求完全一致；不得修改输入。引用随包材料并保留可复核的来源定位；不得将出题假设写成真实业务事实。

法律替代成稿使用英文，可直接替换原稿；分析、表格与说明允许中文或英文。所有公司、人员、地址、交易与工资事实均为演练假设。

gold.description: 八条英文直接替代政策及条款
gold.text:
Employee reporting and record-access policy

Scope

仅按随包2025 CFR美国联邦法历史版本演练，非现行法完整法律意见；适用于本委托已确认受联邦1904覆盖的制造厂。

P1

Report work-related injuries and illnesses promptly and accurately when you become aware of them. Use a reasonable procedure that does not deter reporting; no automatic discipline solely because a latent condition was not recognized before shift end.

Authority: CFR_1904_35_2025.pdf §1904.35(b)(1)(i)

P2

Report through your supervisor or the designated HR/Safety reporting channel. HR must tell each employee how to use these channels.

Authority: CFR_1904_35_2025.pdf §1904.35(b)(1)(ii)

P3

Employees have the right to report work-related injuries and illnesses.

Authority: CFR_1904_35_2025.pdf §1904.35(b)(1)(iii)(A)

P4

Do not discharge or discriminate against an employee for reporting a work-related injury or illness. Raise suspected retaliation with HR/Safety.

Authority: CFR_1904_35_2025.pdf §1904.35(b)(1)(iii)(B),(iv)

P5

Provide a relevant current or stored OSHA 300 Log to eligible employees/former employees or representatives by the end of the next business day; do not remove names already properly in that Log. Preserve lawful privacy-case recording protections; do not add omitted names.

Authority: CFR_1904_35_2025.pdf §1904.35(b)(2)(iii),(iv)

P6

An authorized collective-bargaining representative receives only the Tell us about the case section of OSHA 301 reports for the represented establishment within seven calendar days; remove all other information.

Authority: CFR_1904_35_2025.pdf §1904.35(b)(2)(v)(B)

P7

Do not charge for the first required copies; a reasonable retrieval/copying charge may apply for additional copies.

Authority: CFR_1904_35_2025.pdf §1904.35(b)(2)(vi)

P8

For an individual OSHA 301 request, verify the requester is that employee/former employee or their personal representative; a personal representative is designated in writing or the legal representative of a deceased or legally incapacitated employee.

Authority: CFR_1904_35_2025.pdf §1904.35(b)(2)(ii),(v)(A)

gold.description: 四条可执行主管培训卡
gold.text:
Supervisor action card

Scope

美国联邦法历史演练，依据随包2025 CFR，非现行法完整法律意见。

1 — Accept reports

Accept prompt accurate reports when the employee becomes aware; do not impose automatic punishment for delayed recognition. If you are absent, direct the employee to HR/Safety. §1904.35(b)(1)(i),(ii).

2 — Prevent retaliation

Tell employees they may report injuries and illness. Do not threaten a reporting-linked bonus loss or discharge. Escalate retaliation concerns to HR/Safety. §1904.35(b)(1)(iii),(iv).

3 — Route access

Immediately forward record requests to HR/Safety. Individual300/own301 normally use next-business-day deadline; authorized union301 requests use seven-calendar-day rule and limited case-section disclosure. §1904.35(b)(2)(iii),(v).

4 — Protect access boundaries

Verify requester identity and written designation when needed. Do not release colleague301 to an informal friend. Do not charge for first copies or blanket-redact300 names; respect legitimate privacy-case recording protections. §1904.35(b)(2)(ii),(iv),(vi).
